div.l: A sompnore and A Pardener also
A Mancipill and my selfe there was nomo
There was also a Reve and eke a Millere also
THe myller was a stout carle for the nones
Fulle bigge he was of brayne and bones
That proued welle for evir there he cam
At wrastlynge alwey he wolde alwey haue the ram
He was short shuldred a thicke qnarre
There was no dore that he nolde heue of the barre
Or breke it at rennynge with his hede .
His berde as eny sowe or wex was rede
And therto brode as hit were a spade
Vppon the cop of his nose he had
A wert and theron stode a tuft of heres
Rede as the brustles of a sowes eres
His nostrelles blake were and wide
A swerde and a bokerer bare he by his side
Hit mouth as grete as a furneys
He was a iangeler and a ioly hardeys
And that was most of synne and harlotryes
Wolle coude he stele corne and tolle thryes
And that he had thombe of golde parde .
A white cote and blewe hode wered he .
A bagpipe coude he blowe and sowne .
And therwᵗith he brought out of towne
A Gentille Manciple was there of the temple
Of whiche a catour myght take ensample
For to be wise in beynge of vitaille
For to be wise in beynge of vitaille
For whedir he payde or toke be taile
Algate he wayted so on his acate /
